# Chimera Security Laboratory

Chimera provides an authorized security-testing architecture rather than copying Kali source code. Kali organizes its tooling into information gathering, vulnerability assessment, web, database, password, wireless, reverse-engineering, exploitation, forensics, fuzzing, reporting and other categories. citeturn0search3turn0search8

Chimera maps those categories into native adapters and isolated tool environments. Tools execute only against explicitly authorized targets and inherit Aegis policy. Destructive exploitation, credential theft and malware-generation paths are not enabled as autonomous OS behavior.

See the official Kali documentation for the complete current tool catalog. citeturn0search0turn0search5
